thread:
Alex K: Heads-up — quick thread to capture outstanding Qs from today's all-hands about sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partner updates. Drop items and leadership will respond.
Mira S: Quick Q — for the new channel partner pilot, what's the qualification criteria? e.g., ARR, number of joint customers, technical integration level?
Dave P: We're piloting with 3 partners: CloudHub, DataBridge, EdgeWorks. Criteria we're using: >$1M ARR, 2+ joint customers, engineering capacity for SSO + a simple connector. Putting together a one-pager.
Sarah L: Priority is partners that accelerate enterprise deals in NA/EU. We'll consider one high-touch APAC partner later. @Dave P please share the partner matrix by EOD Friday.
Dave P: Will do. Draft matrix here: https://redwood.app/sheets/partner-pilot-matrix (internal).
Jess R: For sales coverage — what's the lead handoff process? We need a playbook and lead scoring to avoid duplicate outreach and missed SLAs.
Alex K: Agreed. Proposed flow: 1) Partner sends lead → 2) RevOps tags & scores → 3) AE assigned within 24h. @Jess R can you own the playbook?
Jess R: Yes, I'll publish a short playbook and drop it in #sales-playbooks by Monday. cc @Mira S
Mira S: Also, what’s included in the new enterprise SKU we hinted at during the deck?
Bryan M: Enterprise SKU = committed reserved capacity + private deployment option + 24/7 support and an onboarding migration package. Pricing bands are draft — see slide 12 for ranges.
Sarah L: Pricing team to finalize rates by next Wed. We'll offer migration credits for existing customers shifting to Enterprise.
Alex K: Pipeline ops note: please flag deals > $250k to the Deal Desk so legal & finance can fast-track reviews.
Dave P: Partner co-sell economics for the pilot: 10% referral/rev share (pilot only, subject to change with scale).
Jess R: Action items recap: I own the playbook; Dave to share matrix; Pricing to finalize enterprise bands. Can someone create a single tracker so we avoid multiple spreadsheets?
Alex K: Created tracker: https://redwood.app/trackers/market-engagement (internal). Please add partner rows with current status. Example row format:
```
Partner | Stage | Intro Date | Assigned AE | Next action
```
Dave P: I'll start populating CloudHub & DataBridge rows today.
ops-bot: Reminder: All-hands follow-up survey closes in 24h — please fill it out.
Sarah L: Thanks everyone — we'll post a short summary doc with owners and due dates. If anyone needs a warm intro for partner conversations, DM me. :thumbsup:
